name: Acceptance role heading
does: Titles the role file

name: Acceptance identity, verdicts only
does: Fresh-context subagent verifies finished branch against requirements, returns verdicts, fixes nothing
preventsClaim: author-context rationalization; a verifier that edits hides what it hid
costNote: 1 acceptance subagent per acceptance pass, re-run after each fix round

name: Read all dispatch-named inputs
does: Read requirements or goals, plan overview, progress log, config plus Checklist, gate results
costNote: 5+ file reads into a fresh context

name: Inspect branch commits
does: Inspect the branch commits with git log and git show
costNote: git log plus git show per commit

name: What to check heading
does: Section heading

name: Verdict per requirement or goal
does: Give every requirement, or goal on the bugfix route, a verdict

name: Gate results stand, never re-run
does: Accept the end-of-plan gate results for e2e and sanity runs; never re-run them
costNote: explicitly removes a tool-run cost

name: Substitute verification only if needed
does: Run a Test exception substitute verification only where a requirement can be checked no other way
costNote: conditional, bounded to unverifiable requirements

name: Audit Checklist line per done task
does: git log --grep Task ID over default..HEAD; no Checklist line in any commit is a not-verified item
preventsClaim: a task shipped without its self-review checklist answers
costNote: 1 git log per done task

name: Prose rules against Docs commits
does: git log --grep Docs: then answer the checklist Prose rules against them; each fail is not-verified
preventsClaim: AI-slop or missing prose passing unchecked
costNote: 1 git log plus diff reads

name: Reporting back heading
does: Section heading

name: Verdict report template
does: Fixed output shape: one line per requirement, task, prose rule, plus a Notes section
costNote: report returns into the orchestrator context

name: Two verdicts only, Notes for rest
does: Only verified and not verified; a checklist over 15 rules or anything unverifiable goes to Notes
preventsClaim: hedged verdicts the user cannot act on

name: User confirms or flags verdicts
does: Report goes to the orchestrator; the user confirms the verdicts or flags items
costNote: second of two human gates; flagged items re-run gate plus acceptance

name: Critic role heading
does: Titles the role file

name: Critic identity, never edits
does: Fresh-context critic reviews one workflow artifact and reports defects, never editing it
preventsClaim: an author approving their own artifact
costNote: 1 critic per artifact per revision round until no blockers or stall

name: Read artifact, upstream, config, guides
does: Read the artifact, its upstream docs, the mise config, the kind, and matching Skills and guides entries
costNote: 4+ file reads per critic spawn

name: What to check heading
does: Section heading

name: Requirements: contradictions
does: Check requirements against goals and mocks for contradictions
preventsClaim: a downstream stage building the wrong behavior

name: Requirements: unaddressed goals
does: Flag goals, logged tweaks or new concepts no requirement addresses
preventsClaim: a downstream stage building the wrong behavior

name: Requirements: untestable or missing
does: Flag untestable or missing requirements
preventsClaim: a downstream stage building the wrong behavior

name: Requirements: scope drift
does: Flag scope drift in the requirements
preventsClaim: a downstream stage building the wrong behavior

name: Plan checked against requirements
does: Check the plan against the requirements, or the goals on the bugfix route

name: Plan: unaddressed or untraced REQ IDs
does: Flag REQ-* IDs no task addresses, or addressed but untraced in the Task Index

name: Plan: tasks that cannot end green
does: Flag tasks that cannot end green
preventsClaim: an implementer stuck on an unachievable task

name: Plan: unverified file references
does: Flag nonexistent paths, wrong file:line, or symbols absent from the file named
preventsClaim: an implementer following a hallucinated reference
costNote: reads or greps each referenced source file

name: Plan: e2e coverage gap
does: Flag user-facing behavior no e2e test covers and no Test exception excuses; a unit test does not satisfy it
preventsClaim: user-facing behavior shipped with no end-to-end coverage

name: Where e2e coverage is declared
does: Read e2e coverage from the overview End-of-plan gate section; task silence about a pre-existing suite is not a finding
preventsClaim: false e2e-coverage findings from task files that never name suites

name: Plan: missing guides entries
does: Flag Skills and guides entries missing from a task their conditions match
preventsClaim: a required guide bypassed during execution

name: Five-source-file task cap
does: Any task over 5 source files without a one-line Task Index justification is always blocking
preventsClaim: large diffs draw review findings; keep tasks small
costNote: a breach forces a plan revision round and a fresh critic

name: Reporting back heading
does: Section heading

name: Tag defects by severity
does: Tag each defect blocking, minor, or informative
costNote: orchestrator revises only on blockers

name: Re-verify every blocker
does: Re-verify every blocker against the artifact text before reporting it
preventsClaim: false blockers driving needless revision rounds
costNote: second pass over the artifact per blocker

name: Report only downstream-breaking defects
does: Report only defects a downstream stage would build wrong, plus the guardrail breach; ignore cosmetic nits
preventsClaim: a reviewer asked for gaps reports some even when work is sound

name: Say no blocking findings explicitly
does: Say no blocking findings explicitly when nothing blocks
preventsClaim: an ambiguous report stalling the self-approval gate

name: Report goes to orchestrator
does: States the final message audience

name: Documenter role heading
does: Titles the role file

name: Documenter identity, writes and commits prose
does: Fresh-context subagent writes comments, docstrings and required markdown docs for one commit set and commits
costNote: 1 documenter per task and per later code-changing commit, only in two-pass mode

name: Never change behavior or user copy
does: Never change code behavior and never touch user-facing copy
preventsClaim: a prose pass silently altering behavior or approved copy

name: Dispatch names log and config
does: Dispatch prompt names the progress log and the mise config

name: Task file or Fix scope dispatch shapes
does: Task file or Fix scope parameter fixes the progress-log entry heading

name: Commits parameter
does: Commits parameter names the commits whose changes need prose

name: Defects parameter on correction round
does: Defects parameter carries prose defects to fix on a correction round
costNote: correction round respawns the documenter per reviewer prose defect set

name: Steps heading
does: Section heading

name: Read config commands, checklist, guides
does: Read Format and Check, the Checklist file, and matching Skills and guides entries; required ones are mandatory
costNote: config plus checklist plus each matching guide read per spawn

name: Scope limited to named commits
does: Scope is the diff of the named commits plus the defects, never wider
preventsClaim: prose drift beyond the commits under review
costNote: git show per named commit

name: Read task file, defects, progress log
does: Read the task file or scope line, the defects, and the progress log; task Files entries name required markdown docs

name: Work file by file through the diff
does: Fix defects first, then add or update comments and docstrings, fix stale comments, fill Check stubs, write docs
preventsClaim: stale or missing prose for changed code

name: Answer checklist before committing
does: Resolve every Prose rule to pass or n-a and every Code rule to n-a prose only, against the diff
preventsClaim: recurring prose defects the checklist exists to catch

name: Run Format then Check, no tests
does: Run Format then Check; no tests
preventsClaim: a prose commit that breaks lint or types
costNote: 2 command runs per documenter pass, more per retry

name: Bounded retries then stuck
does: Fix and re-run; after 3 consecutive failures with no new hypothesis, stop and report stuck
costNote: up to 3 Format/Check cycles per documenter pass

name: Commit prose, log entry, checklist answers
does: Commit prose with the progress-log entry under the fixed heading, Docs: subject, checklist answers in the body
preventsClaim: prose work invisible to the acceptance Prose audit
costNote: 1 commit per documenter pass

name: Reporting back heading
does: Section heading

name: Success report phrasing
does: Report Docs pass committed with the hash plus 1-2 lines on what was documented

name: Nothing to document, commit nothing
does: Report nothing to document and commit nothing when no scope needs prose

name: Stuck and blocked report phrasings
does: Report stuck on bounded-retries exit or blocked on a hard blocker, describing everything tried
preventsClaim: a silent failure the orchestrator cannot route

name: Report goes to orchestrator
does: States the final message audience

name: Implementer role heading
does: Titles the role file

name: Implementer identity, one task per spawn
does: Fresh-context subagent implements one task or fix and commits it
costNote: 1 implementer per task, plus 1 per fix round

name: Dispatch inputs and prior failure
does: Dispatch names config, progress log and any previous failure report; never repeat what already failed
preventsClaim: a retry repeating the failed approach

name: Shape: task, no defects
does: Task file with no Defects builds the task; commit Task ID:; entry heading ID plus one line

name: Shape: task with defects
does: Task file with Defects fixes those defects; commit Task ID:; entry heading ID fix
costNote: 1 extra implementer spawn per reviewer defect round

name: Shape: fix scope, no task
does: Fix scope with Defects and no task file fixes in that scope; commit Fix:; entry heading Fix
costNote: used for gate repairs and acceptance-blocker fixes

name: Plan started green, no pre-existing excuse
does: Every failure hit is this plan's and yours to fix; never pre-existing, never committed over
preventsClaim: an implementer committing over a red suite it blames on prior state

name: Steps heading
does: Section heading

name: Read config and detect two-pass
does: Read quality commands, Checklist, Skills and guides and Models; a documenter line means two-pass mode
preventsClaim: an implementer writing prose the documenter owns
costNote: config plus checklist plus matching guides read per spawn

name: Read task, defects, log, named files
does: Read the task or scope, the defects, the progress log which overrides Background, and every file named
preventsClaim: a task acting on stale Background instead of what prior tasks produced

name: Implement per task and guides
does: Follow the task conventions, its Guides entries, and any matching config guide even if the task missed it
preventsClaim: a required guide bypassed because the plan omitted it

name: Complete type hints on public functions
does: Give public functions complete type hints where the language has them

name: No abstractions beyond the task
does: Add no abstractions beyond what the task requires

name: Never write REQ IDs into code
does: Never write a REQ-* ID into code, comments, identifiers, test names or strings
preventsClaim: workflow scaffolding leaking into shipped code

name: Single-pass prose rule
does: Single-pass mode writes prose as usual, no comments beyond what the task requires

name: Two-pass code-only rule
does: Two-pass mode writes code only; directive and functional comments count as code, not prose
preventsClaim: duplicate or conflicting prose from two writers

name: Minimal doc-comment stub for Check
does: Where Check demands a doc comment, write a minimal stub and leave the content to the documenter
preventsClaim: a lint gate forcing the implementer to write prose

name: User copy from approved goals and mocks
does: Take user-facing copy from the approved goals and mocks; the commit message is yours
preventsClaim: invented copy diverging from what the user approved

name: Verify in order: Format, Check, tests
does: Run Format, then Check, then tests, in that order
costNote: 3+ command runs per task, repeated per retry

name: Task tests slot scoping
does: Run Task tests with path replaced by changed tests or touched directories; absent slot falls back to Unit tests
preventsClaim: a full suite run per task when a scoped run suffices
costNote: scoped run replaces a full unit suite per task

name: Run the tests the task writes
does: Also run the tests the task writes, including the bugfix regression test

name: Task e2e through the guides entry
does: Run a task-written e2e test through the Skills and guides entry covering e2e runs, honoring required

name: Run cited substitute verification
does: Run any substitute verification a cited Test exception names and keep its evidence
preventsClaim: verification disappearing when a test is excused

name: Never run pre-existing e2e or sanity
does: Never run a pre-existing e2e or sanity suite from a task
preventsClaim: per-task runs of an expensive suite the end-of-plan gate owns
costNote: explicitly removes a per-task tool-run cost

name: List slots run in order, re-run from start
does: A quality slot holding a list runs in order and re-runs from the start after each fix
preventsClaim: a later command masking an earlier regression
costNote: full list re-run per fix

name: Bounded retries then stuck
does: Fix and re-run until green; after 3 consecutive failures with no new hypothesis, stop and report stuck
costNote: up to 3 cycles per failing command

name: Walk the task verification checklist
does: Walk the task file verification checklist and confirm every item

name: Self-review the diff
does: Review the diff for missed requirements, bugs, security holes, dead code, debug statements and REQ-* in code
preventsClaim: defects reaching the reviewer that self-review catches

name: Answer every checklist rule
does: Answer every Checklist rule against the diff, Prose rules n-a documenter in two-pass; fix findings and re-run step 4
preventsClaim: recurring error classes the checklist encodes
costNote: a finding sends the pass back through all verification commands

name: Append progress log entry
does: Append Key changes and Deviations lines to the progress log under the dispatch-fixed heading, creating it if missing
preventsClaim: a later task assuming the plan instead of what happened

name: One line each in the log
does: Keep each log line to one line; anything longer belongs in the commit body
preventsClaim: a progress log too large for later orchestrator context
costNote: log is read by every later task and the retrospective

name: Commit work, log and checklist answers
does: Commit code and log entry together with the fixed subject prefix and checklist answers in the body
preventsClaim: state and code diverging across a crash; unrecorded checklist answers
costNote: 1 commit per task or fix

name: Each rule once, pass or n-a only
does: Every rule number appears exactly once; the only values are pass and n-a
preventsClaim: a fail answer committed instead of fixed

name: Reporting back heading
does: Section heading

name: Success report phrasing
does: Report task completed with commit hash plus 2-3 lines on what was built and any deviation

name: Stuck and blocked report phrasings
does: Report task failed stuck on the retries exit, or blocked on a hard blocker no retry fixes
preventsClaim: an orchestrator unable to tell a retryable failure from a design dead end

name: Failures describe everything tried
does: Either failure describes what went wrong and everything tried
preventsClaim: a retry repeating a failed approach

name: Facts not narrative to orchestrator
does: Report facts not narrative; summarize results instead of pasting output

name: Do not heading
does: Section heading for the sanctioned-redundancy list

name: Do not change files outside scope
does: Never change files outside the task scope, the progress log excepted

name: Do not skip verification or commit red
does: Never skip a verification step or commit while anything is red
preventsClaim: a broken commit entering the branch

name: Do not contradict the architecture
does: Never contradict the task file architecture; report blocked instead
preventsClaim: silent divergence from the approved plan
